ibes.link: wrdsapps_link_crsp_ibes__ibcrsphist, score<=2, INTERVAL join on anndats
ibes.share_basis: surpsumu is the UNADJUSTED summary; actual, surpmean and surpstdev are all from that one file, so SUE is basis-consistent. The price-scaled surprise divides the same unadjusted numerator by CRSP RAW prc (cfacpr NOT applied) -- the matching basis.
ibes.pit: anndats is both the event and its availability (the actual EPS IS the announcement). DATE precision only: IBES surpsumu carries no time of day, so entry is the announcement session's CLOSE and every clock starts at +1.

DECLARED_BIASES.survivorship: universe resolved via company_tickers.json = CURRENT registrants; names delisted before the map's fetch date are absent
DECLARED_BIASES.truncation: the default pull reads only `filings.recent` (~1,000 most recent filings per CIK, all forms); a heavy filer's 8-K history is TRUNCATED at its coverage_start. Absence of a row before coverage_start is truncation, not evidence of no filing. --full-history fetches the older pages.
DECLARED_BIASES.measured_here: 1061 of 1062 CIKs filing in 2015 also file in 2024 -- the CIK list is a MODERN universe replayed backwards, so a name delisted before the collector ran is absent from every earlier year. Direction of the bias: toward survivors, i.e. UPWARD on any return computed from it.

eightk.verdict: SLICE -- gradeable as a conditional event study inside the surviving set, NOT as a book over a universe.

WHICH_READING_EVERY_NUMBER_IS_CONDITIONE.A_month_fraction: months of the year with any NEWS row. A PIPELINE-HEALTH number. 75%-100%. It is what caught the 03:18 death and it says nothing about how many companies are covered.
WHICH_READING_EVERY_NUMBER_IS_CONDITIONE.B_news_universe_fraction: distinct NEWS symbols with >=1 row that year / the 12,198-name tradable universe. 0.8%-1.2% for 2015-2024, 43.7%/46.1% for 2025/2026. Terminal receipt, not re-derived.
WHICH_READING_EVERY_NUMBER_IS_CONDITIONE.C_event_table_permno_share: N4's reading: linked permnos in the event table / CRSP common stock active that year, ALL sources pooled. 80.8%-86.3% for 2015-2024. It is dominated by IBES and 8-K, so it is NOT a news number and reading it as one is the error this table exists to stop.
WHICH_READING_EVERY_NUMBER_IS_CONDITIONE.D_panel_share_THIS_JOB: names in the GRADED MONTHLY PANEL with >=1 event of THIS family in year Y / all panel names that year. The panel is what `evaluate.book` selects from, so D is the only reading that bounds what a book can express. Every family number below is conditioned on D.

reading_D_summary.eightk_gate_90pct: NOT MET in any year -- and the sample is survivor-conditioned

price_panel_bound.note: no daily file after 2024 -- every event clock is bounded above by it, and no amount of news coverage in 2025-2026 can be graded without one

graded_panel_bound.note: the monthly panel `evaluate.book` selects from. It ends the same month the daily files do.

THE_NEWS_LEG_IS_REFUSED.why: 2015-2024 has a price panel and ~1% news coverage of the tradable universe; 2025-2026 has 43.7%/46.1% news coverage and NO price panel (CRSP daily ends 2024-12-31, the monthly panel ends 2024-12). There is no year in which a news-conditioned event book can be both built and graded. This is a property of the tape, not of the hypothesis.
THE_NEWS_LEG_IS_REFUSED.what_would_lift_it: either the 2015-2024 whole-market Alpaca pull (~50 h, resumable, command in BUILD_2026-09-07b_E1_NEWS_PULLER.md §8) or a 2025-2026 daily price file. The pull is the cheaper of the two.

months_excluded_and_why.why: DONE but NOT FULL -- a 17-hour DNS outage on 2026-09-07/08. `--list-degraded` in the terminal repo names them. They are NOT averaged over here because the news leg is refused outright, so no number in this document depends on them.
months_excluded_and_why.eightk_years_excluded: 2013-2016 are reported but never traded: the manifest's median coverage_start is 2016-02-09, so an absence before it is truncation, not a company that filed nothing.
